mintAuthority.summary: WBRL has independent native issuer deployments on Ethereum, Base, World Chain, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and since the 2026-09-05 closeout also Celo and HyperEVM. On the six original deployments the shared Ripio EOA holds MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE, the 4-of-7 Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and the issuer's LimitedMinter facility is a native cap-limited minter on Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis; on the Celo and HyperEVM deployments the same 4-of-7 Safe itself holds MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE while the shared EOA held no token roles at the 2026-09-05 fixed reads. The separate LimitedMinterBridge/BridgeDeposit burn-mint rail is reviewed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Ripio WBRL Safe multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) returned true. getOwners() returned 7 owners; getThreshold() returned 4. getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules). slot0 masterCopy = 0x41675c...61a (Safe v1.4.1 singleton). fallbackHandler = 0xfd0732...ec99 (standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler). getGuard() reverted (no guard).

controls.label: Ripio WBRL Safe multisig (Celo direct MINTER_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE)
controls.evidence: In the 2026-09-05 read session (Celo blocks 76692483-76693382) WBRL hasRole reads returned true for this Safe on MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and false for the shared issuer EOA 0x466c02e2cc67b81a696af5afdb61605c41fe247b on all four roles, so the Safe is the observed direct minter and UUPS upgrader on this deployment with no timelock observed between it and either role. The proxy's slot-0 singleton 0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762 returned VERSION() 1.4.1 when called directly, getThreshold() returned 4, getOwners() returned the seven owners recorded for the tracked chains, the deprecated getModules() returned an empty array (getModulesPaginated reverted GS105 through the proxy), and the guard storage slot keyed by the Safe address read zero, so no module or guard was detected. Role-holder enumeration beyond the Safe, the issuer EOA, BridgeDeposit, and LimitedMinterBridge was not performed; canRaiseCap is unknown.

controls.label: Ripio WBRL native LimitedMinter contract
controls.evidence: At the fixed 2026-08-16 reads, 0xd168cfbbe260d48cd119497a9a2ee8482080c5e7 held MINTER_ROLE on WBRL at Ethereum block 25771239, BSC block 116369053, Polygon block 92147851, and Gnosis block 47763178; it was not a minter on Base block 50068727 or World Chain block 33795582. The verified LimitedMinter source fixes a mint destination and applies a daily cap, making this an issuer-operated native facility rather than the arbitrary-recipient LimitedMinterBridge route.

review.evidence: All native mint-capable role holders verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at block 25295015. EOA 0x466c02e2 confirmed via eth_getCode. Safe 0x2b839174 confirmed as 4/7 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules or guard. The native LimitedMinter 0xd168cfbb is separately scoped to Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis by the fixed 2026-08-16 role reads. Supervision review (2026-08-08): an independent third-party reserve certification exists - Pablo Eduardo Soto, CPA (CPCECABA Vol. 275 Folio 153) reconciled 719,448 wBRL outstanding across six chains against R$809,597.28 in a Brazilian bank account as of 2026-03-31 - so reserve evidence is attestation-backed rather than absent. Reconciliation stays unknown because Ripio labels this the first attestation of wBRL collateral, the wFIAT whitepaper commits only to attestations that 'may' be published periodically, and later-period certifications return 404. No prudential regime applies: the issuer is described only as a Ripio group affiliate, and the disclosed CNV PSAV and Florida money-transmitter registrations cover other group entities. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled minters are uncapped across six chains, and the sole whole-supply certification is ad hoc rather than recurring. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: no later WBRL certification was found, and Ripio's July Celo launch added a seventh deployment outside the March six-chain snapshot; reconciliation remains unknown. Wave 1 reconciliation review: Pablo Eduardo Soto's 2026-03-31 certification reconciles wBRL issuance and burn records to Brazilian bank collateral, but Ripio's official wFIAT page calls it the first wBRL attestation and publishes no later report or recurring cadence; reconciliation remains unknown. Boundary migration review on 2026-08-16 retains the shared issuer EOA, Safe, native LimitedMinter, and six native UUPS upgrade targets in Mint Authority; the separate LimitedMinterBridge and BridgeDeposit burn-mint machinery is structured under Bridge Risk. The unlisted Celo deployment remains outside the authored native set pending catalog-owner scope adjudication. U5 closeout 2026-09-05 (RipioRailsCloseout): the Celo and HyperEVM native deployments were verified by fixed JSON-RPC reads (Celo blocks 76692483-76693382, HyperEVM blocks 45075964-45076875). Both proxies resolve the tracked master implementation 0xfbab5dcb1647787ec8402a6509add256fa6c7f9d; on both chains the 4-of-7 Ripio Safe 0x2b839174fe62466067c22e2a4c8054071f9d8d68 currently holds MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (Safe v1.4.1, no modules, no guard at the same reads) while the shared issuer EOA holds none, and LimitedMinterBridge 0x46167cb034fec6cec46caed4f61281f5aa0eb0e6 additionally holds MINTER_ROLE. The earlier sentence leaving the Celo deployment outside the authored native set is superseded: Celo and HyperEVM are now authored. The six-chain legacy role state is unchanged from the 2026-08-16 reads and was not re-audited.
